title: Shirataki Noodle Stir-Fry with Chicken & Veggies
description: The combination of beta-glucans in cremini mushrooms and glucomannan in shirataki creates a powerful dual-fiber barrier that blunts carbohydrate absorption and aids bile acid binding.
diabeticNotes: The combination of beta-glucans in cremini mushrooms and glucomannan in shirataki creates a powerful dual-fiber barrier that blunts carbohydrate absorption and aids bile acid binding.

ingredients.name: packet Shirataki / Konjac noodles (rinsed and drained)
skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
avocado oil or cold-pressed sesame oil

steps.title: Rinse & Dry-Sear Noodles
steps.description: Rinse shirataki noodles thoroughly in cold water, parboil for 1 minute, drain, and dry-sear in a hot pan.

steps.title: Stir-Fry Sliced Chicken
steps.description: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry sliced chicken breast for 4 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Cook Crisp Vegetables
steps.description: Add sliced bell pepper, trimmed snap peas, and cremini mushrooms. Stir-fry for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.

steps.title: Add Noodles & Sauce
steps.description: Add prepared shirataki noodles and pour tamari soy sauce over the mixture.

steps.title: Toss & Glaze
steps.description: Toss vigorously for 2 minutes until sauce coats noodles and vegetables evenly. Serve hot.
